title: "V0010 chained_comparison"

An error from the `parse` phase. `sakura explain V0010` prints this explanation offline.

Comparison operators do not chain (design §3.1).

Wrong:

```sakura
if a < b < c { … }
```

Fixed:

```sakura
if a < b && b < c { … }
```
